The main takeaway from our work is that
the TIN-achieved GDoF region has a very nice combinatorial structure, which is useful for both analysis and design of interference channels.

, in the regime of high SNR, interference can indeed be optimally treated as noise in a large class of interference networks, and the TIN-optimality can be determined with the aid of combinatorial optimization techniques.
, in the context of combinatorial optimization, treating interference as noise is not necessarily sub-optimal.
